newsitem.title: USA: Cohu sees sales, net lower in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Cohu sees sales, net lower in Q4.

text.p: Cohu Inc said on Friday its sales and net income would continue to fall in the fourth quarter.

The supplier of semiconductor test handling equipment, reporting lower third quarter results, said backlog at the end of the third quarter was $27.3 million, compared with year-end 1995 backlog of $45.4 million and June 30, 1996, backlog of $38.1 million.

Charles Schwan, president and chief executive, said, "The reduced level of backlog at Sept 30, 1996, indicates that the company's downward trend in sales and net income will continue in the 1996 fourth quarter.
"We have instituted cost-reduction programs and will continue to review production capacity, work force and other aspects of our cost structure."
He added, "... We continue to invest heavily in research and development, which increased 41 percent in the first nine months of 1996 compared to 1995."
